neighbours.label: The opening word of a gloss that defines a unit or technical term just used, e.g. '(A terabyte is ...' or '. An exaflop is ...', as opposed to parentheses that cite, point to a figure, or add an aside.
fire: The new camera records 8K video at sixty frames a second. (A frame is one still image.)
Each tanker carries about two million barrels. (A barrel is roughly 159 litres.)
The fund lost forty basis points last quarter. (A basis point is one hundredth of a percent.)
Some pulsars spin hundreds of times per second. A pulsar is a rapidly rotating neutron star.
The plot covered almost three hectares. (A hectare is ten thousand square metres.)
The quake released energy measured in petajoules. A petajoule is a million billion joules.
Engineers quoted the bridge's load in kilonewtons. (A kilonewton is a thousand newtons.)
The galaxy lies about two megaparsecs away. (A megaparsec is about 3.26 million light years.)
quiet: The new camera records 8K video at sixty frames a second (see the spec sheet for details).
Each tanker carries about two million barrels (Shipping Review, 2019).
The fund lost forty basis points last quarter, its worst result in years.
Some pulsars spin hundreds of times per second, as the survey in Table 3 shows.
The plot covered almost three hectares (the old map is wrong about this).
The quake released a great deal of energy, and buildings swayed for a minute.
Engineers quoted the bridge's load in kilonewtons (Figure 4).
The galaxy lies about two megaparsecs away, according to the new survey.
